comment: Attribute and property keys whose values never leave the process, whichever agent saw them. A filtered key keeps its place and its value becomes "[FILTERED]". Matching is case-insensitive and anywhere in the key. A session is filtered as an identifier (session, session_id, a Rails _app_session cookie), not as a word: session_kind is kept. Counts are not secrets: a key naming tokens in the plural (input_tokens, totalTokens) is kept.
